[aidevops.sh](https://aidevops.sh) v3.39.147 plugin for [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai)

Walkthrough

The contact-form ability now tries configurable providers in order, including Ninja Forms, and returns a shortcode for a created Ninja Forms form. The change also adds a Ninja Forms submission trigger and updates plugin catalog entries, contact-form guidance, and tests. **Changes: Ninja Forms contact-form creation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Provider selection and form creation**
`includes/Abilities/ContentAbilities.php`, `stubs/ninja-forms.php`, `phpstan.neon`, `tests/SdAiAgent/Abilities/ContentAbilitiesTest.php`|The ability tries providers in the configured order and keeps the HTML fallback when no provider returns a result. Ninja Forms creation saves form settings, fields, and actions; updates the form cache; and returns a shortcode. Tests cover provider selection, fallback behavior, field and action settings, and form creation. PHPStan scans declarations for the Ninja Forms APIs used by the code.| **Submission trigger, plugin catalog, and guidance** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Ninja Forms submission trigger**
`includes/Automations/EventTriggerRegistry.php`, `tests/SdAiAgent/Automations/EventTriggerRegistryTest.php`|The trigger registry adds `ninja_forms_after_submission` when Ninja Forms is available. The test checks its argument and placeholders, and checks that the trigger is absent when Ninja Forms is unavailable.| |**Plugin catalog and contact-form guidance**
`includes/Core/AbilityPluginRegistry.php`, `includes/Models/skills/contact-forms.md`|The catalog adds Ninja Forms and revises the WPForms Lite and Contact Form 7 descriptions. The guide updates provider order, setup instructions, shortcode details, and provider verification.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~25 minutes **Change:** Feature · **Severity of issue fixed:** Medium ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Agent participant ContentAbilities participant Ninja_Forms participant WPN_Helper Agent->>ContentAbilities: Request contact-form creation ContentAbilities->>Ninja_Forms: Save form, fields, and actions ContentAbilities->>WPN_Helper: Update form cache ContentAbilities-->>Agent: Return form ID and shortcode ```
Merge Risk: Moderate · up to 5e521

Ninja Forms contact forms may fail to send notification emails because the From Address uses an unrecognized merge tag. Fix this before merging. Test isolation and the catalog and guide inaccuracies are lower-impact follow-ups.
Pre-merge checks: 4

| Check name | Status | Explanation | | :------------------------ | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------: | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Linked Issues check | ![Passed](https://storage.googleapis.com/coderabbit_public_assets/pre-merge-checks-passed.svg) | Issue `#3003` is the only directly linked issue, and it is open. Its coding requirements are met by the changes in ContentAbilities.php, AbilityPluginRegistry.php, EventTriggerRegistry.php, contact-form… | | Out of Scope Changes check | ![Passed](https://storage.googleapis.com/coderabbit_public_assets/pre-merge-checks-passed.svg) | All changed areas map to `#3003` requirements: the provider and filter in ContentAbilities.php, the catalog entry and WPForms/CF7 wording in AbilityPluginRegistry.php, the trigger in EventTriggerRegistr… | | Description Check | ![Passed](https://storage.googleapis.com/coderabbit_public_assets/pre-merge-checks-passed.svg) | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Title check | ![Passed](https://storage.googleapis.com/coderabbit_public_assets/pre-merge-checks-passed.svg) | The title "feat: point the agent at Ninja Forms' own abilities (`#3003`)" matches the main change: the PR adds Ninja Forms as a provider for create-contact-form, with a form, provider selection, a catal… |
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#3003` is the only directly linked issue, and it is open. Its coding requirements are met by the changes in ContentAbilities.php, AbilityPluginRegistry.php, EventTriggerRegistry.php, contact-forms.md, and the stubs. The PR adds a ninja-forms provider that runs first, then WPForms Lite when active, then Contact Form 7, then the HTML block. It adds the sd_ai_agent_contact_form_providers filter. The form has Name, Email, Subject, Message and a submit button, with save, email (reply-to submitter) and success actions. The result uses provider ninja-forms, a [ninja_form id="N"] shortcode, a shortcode block, and no affected descriptor. It adds the catalog entry, the 'Ninja Form Submitted' trigger on ninja_forms_after_submission, and the skill update. Unit tests cover provider selection, fields, actions, fallback, and trigger registration. Gap: the issue lists .wp-env.json (install Ninja Forms in the test environment) as a file to modify. The file at head does not install Ninja Forms, so the one integration test skips in the repository PHPUnit environment. This gap affects test coverage, not the implementation behavior. The author reports manual verification against Ninja Forms 3.15.7, which this review does not reproduce.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** All changed areas map to `#3003` requirements: the provider and filter in ContentAbilities.php, the catalog entry and WPForms/CF7 wording in AbilityPluginRegistry.php, the trigger in EventTriggerRegistry.php, the skill document, phpstan.neon and stubs/ninja-forms.php (typed stubs needed for PHPStan with the new Ninja Forms calls), and the tests. WPForms support is retained as the issue requires. No unrelated change was identified in the summary. The inspection covered only .wp-env.json, so other file-level scope was judged from the summary.
Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title "feat: point the agent at Ninja Forms' own abilities (`#3003`)" matches the main change: the PR adds Ninja Forms as a provider for create-contact-form, with a form, provider selection, a catalog entry, and a trigger. The title names the main feature. It does not name the provider order or the stubs, which is acceptable. The title uses the phrase "point the agent at" and "own abilities", which is loose wording. The linked objectives describe Ninja Forms as a first-class provider for create-contact-form, so the title is related to the change but could be more specific.
